raw_text:
PLAN "Post-Flu Reconditioning Block"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Restore pre-illness strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Re-entry" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A - Squat Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          quad_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B - Hinge Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body C - Press Focus":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          chest_stretch 1m
          child_pose 1m
  PHASE "Phase 2 Rebuild" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Full Body A - Squat Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          quad_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Full Body B - Hinge Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body C - Pull Focus":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          chest_stretch 1m
          child_pose 1m
  PHASE "Phase 3 Restore" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Full Body A - Squat Heavy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x3..5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          quad_stretch 1m
          pigeon_pose 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Full Body B - Volume Moderate":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          side_plank 2x30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full Body C - Deadlift Heavy":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x2..4 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          chest_stretch 1m
          child_pose 1m
